title: Google's New Image AI Costs 3 Cents A Picture
description:
Nano Banana 2.1 (GA Oct 6): $0.0336 per 1K image, $0.113 per 4K. Old Nano Banana 2 was ~$0.067, Nano Banana Pro is $0.134. Batch: $0.0168. No API free tier listed. Source: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing

AI-generated visuals and voice. #Shorts #AI #AItools
